If I could give it 0 stars, I would. I've been wearing false lashes for almost 5 years, and wanted to try magnetic lashes. These are not necessarily magnetic, but are supposed to stick to the eyeliner provided. Eyeliner went on smoothly, but the lashes DID NOT stick at all. Ended up just using my regular lash glue. The eyeliner also smells and was difficult to take off. Too lazy to do a refund because of COVID, but definitely not worth your time or money.

Love them very easy to use and I highly recommend them to any one that needs to save time on their daily beautiful routine Very much worth the money and they look soooo beautiful they are long but that's ok it definitely ups my look I love them I'm definitely buying these again.

I love these. I ordered these by mistake thinking it was regular magnetic eyelashes but i was wrong. The eyeliner went in smooth and was great the lashes stayed put and came off easily with warm water.
I love this eye lashs feels so natural on me!!

Let me start by saying I have magnetic liner/lashes from another company, so I have experience wearing this sort of product.  The biggest issue is that the adhesive used to keep these on the storage tray is SO STICKY you cannot get it off the actual lash band.  Further, the magnets are not along the band, but on the actual lashes. As such, the magnets don't actually come into contact with the magnetic eyeliner, making these utterly pointless.  Magnetic lashes are AMAZING.  Just not these.

reviews.t: These are so easy to use!
reviews.x: I have ordered several lashes since cover started, magnetic mostly that did not work. But these are great!! They are all the same size, a little long and not what I would use for everyday wear but definitely good for date night! They "stick" much better than any of the magnetic ones I've tried, super easy to apply and they held all day even in the heat!!!

Packaging could have been a LOT better but the product itself...AMAZING. I love the eyeline it doesn't have the consistency of the liquid magnetic eyeliner at all just regular liner and the lashes have a full strip of whatever they use for the adhesive and not the 5 little magnet blocks. I recommend if you're on the fence
These eyelashes are so beautiful and so easy to use and they won't come off  they're waterproof sweat proof. Yes I've bought all three pair's of the different eyelashes.

these lashes have become my favorite!! they are so fluffy and full, and i love the dramatic look and if you do too, these are perfect for you. also love the fact that they are magnetic so it’s more convenient to put on and it’s hold is very strong and lasts for a long time. i love how they make my eyes so much bigger and give me that ‘glam’ look. i use them for my everyday!

Just received these today and put them on (the ones in the green box)....WOW!!! Very glamorous without being too OTT. Very light, full and comfortable! I got all 3 versions of these lashes and cannot wait to try the other versions! Highly recommend for a gorgeous, everyday look

I had so much fun working with these. I only got them a few days ago,  but spent time getting the hang of them. Although it wasn't difficult.  No glue, no magnets but somehow they stick very well and stay on. And the eyeliner removes easily!! Can't wait to use them again.

I ordered these by mistake but was pleasantly surprised. I  love how big and fluffy the lashes are and I like the liquid liner they come with. The  adhesive liner is so so, I personally prefer to just use normal eyelash glue with them.

I've only worn lashes once in my life because I didn't want to use blue on my lashes and found them hard to apply. These are super easy to use and worth the money. I will definitely be buying more to use for special occasions.

I really really really love this product. The eyeliner is great, it lasts all day, and you can reuse the lashes. They look amazing. So easy to use I'm never going back to using glue. Buy this product you won't be sorry.

Umm not as picture for sure so long !! More like a drag queen fun night out not a every day looking good type . I tried cutting down 2x still way to crazy ..not what expected not as shown in picture and reviews for sure

These are AMAZING. They were a little long and dramatic for my taste. But I could literally put them on in under 60 seconds. No need to wait for it to be dry and tacky like with lash glue. Absolute life saver.
These are one of the best lashes you'll ever get! The eyeliner that comes with... I don't even bother. You're better off getting your OWN GLUE, but these lashes are still worth it!!! A must buy!!!
I like that they are easy to apply. The eyeliner glue could be stronger but it does it’s job. I love that these lashes are full, thick and soft as well. I will be ordering more very soon. Thanks
I usually don't write reviews, however this product saves me so much money and time. They are so easy to apply, and they stay on all day.  Best of all they make your eyes look fabulous.
Hmmm I didn’t hate the lashes however the lashes were extremely to long and dramatic for day to day use .. even night 🥴 however the eyeliner was amazing was able to use my normal lashes
This was surprisingly easy to use! Its fascinating that its not magnet. And the price is good too. I recommend this for people who struggle trying to get the magnetic lashes to work.
I love this product! I've tried other brands of magnetic eyelashes and this is one is my absolute favorite. The eyeliner pen is much more precise and easier to use. I'm a huge fan.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes easy to apply and long-lasting, staying put through the day.
Reviewers frequently praise the lashes for looking beautiful, fluffy, and glamorous.
Some reviewers report the adhesive liner does not hold strongly enough or the lashes fail to stick at all.
A few reviewers note the lashes are bolder or longer than expected for everyday wear.
Some reviewers mention difficulty applying the liner neatly or issues with the product's packaging/storage adhesive.
